verdict.rationale: E2B lets users explicitly delete sandboxes (kill), control session timeouts, and self-host the entire infrastructure for full data control, which indirectly supports retention/deletion control. However there is no explicit privacy/retention policy, no documented data deletion guarantees for logs/telemetry, and paused sandboxes are 'kept indefinitely' by default, which cuts against automatic data minimization. missing for 10: explicit retention policy/documentation, deletion guarantees for stored data/logs beyond sandbox filesystem, compliance statements (GDPR/CCPA) on data handling.
